notes.title: Cursed Update - Warning v1.3.0
notes.notes:
[h2]Calling All Observers![/h2][h3]This is the third update of the 2025 roadmap for Warning! Check out the upcoming updates in the 2025 roadmap timeline below.[/h3][p]
[b][i]Note: This is the last update in LC Medical. The Next Update will be migrating the game to Coldstone.[/i][/b][/p][hr][/hr][p][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620600/62a154b9d291bc97e2360a7fb35ccee1a0b138f8.png[/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620600/1ee6cd858abc1658753e7f6a1e98aa00a47f0342.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620600/117e58f9f4f3a851d2fd84d10baff8b2ed1cdfe3.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620600/3e936df5e98649555fd6ab19418240431fc1938b.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620600/c490f3495ac9699267f8d388db382d946356924f.png"][/img][list]
[*] New Entering Cutscene.
[*] Changed the discovery system for the ghost room; now players will have to use the cursed tools to discover the ghost room and then start asking questions using the notebook.
[*] New Apps on your in-game computer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620600/43841f9a7e51f17defe32174d6afa854ccdbfd7a.png[/img]
[*] New Inventory System that holds three items sequentially.
[*] Ability to crouch with a remapping option for changing the key in settings (Main Menu).
[*] New Item: Candle
Usage: Put in front of each room. If it lights up, then that room is inhabited by an entity.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620600/bc6da4d6243a8b032f3531776773c05b7f5c8818.png"][/img]
[*] New Item: UV Flashlight 
Usage: Some souls will leave their fingerprints on the door.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620600/bdb3960c009a11b576e4516b8d82fa60cc309684.png"][/img]

[*] The ghost will no longer appear inside the rooms.
[*] Removed the ghost anomaly report option.
[/list]
[b][i]Note: A cursed evidence (Candle lighting up, or Fingerprints on the door) will only happen after a certain amount of time into the round, and will only have one evidence each round.[/i][/b]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620600/c036fa24d12761b6cf4417feda9bbbbc4a918758.png"][/img]
[list]
[*]Fixed some stability issues with the security cameras and the loading times.
[/list]

[hr][/hr][p][b][i]This update does not require manual action; restart Steam to get the latest update automatically.
[/i][/b]
As always, thanks for playing and supporting us! Feel free to share your experience in the community or join our [url="https://discord.com/invite/atNX56k5n7"]🎙️ Official Discord Server[/url]. [/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620600/58783164112c3d14dab9510bebd93c26f670f192.png"][/img]Psychiatric Hospital
173 Brookwell Road, New Hills[/p]

notes.title: Investigation Overhaul! A New Update Available.
notes.notes:
[h2]Calling All Observers![/h2][h3]This is the second update of the 2025 roadmap for Warning! Check out the upcoming updates in the 2025 roadmap timeline below.[/h3][p]
[/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620600/f1a446041a25925767069cd81ee0b87935d1e784.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620600/35931f82a7647377f0e7795084372c209d31e674.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620600/117e58f9f4f3a851d2fd84d10baff8b2ed1cdfe3.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620600/a4a15faa27b384bb2b4a0a3d89aa4ccc544cdd63.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620600/c490f3495ac9699267f8d388db382d946356924f.png"][/img]
[list]
[*]Reworked the Notebook (Journal); It has two tabs, Questions tab is a reworked tab based on the old notebook but now players can select questions by right clicking on the question itself, second tab, Notes, holds the actual important information based on the answers gives by the questions players ask to the ghost.

[*]Reworked the Archives app on the in-game desktop; now it is crucial to the investigation as it holds the archive of all patients, but it needs accurate input for Date and Name to access the patient information.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620600/1f51c406bf7712c6e5f0b4ebf00745e320f11c5f.png"][/img]
[b][i]Note: The date and name can be extracted by asking questions located in the Questions tab of the Notebook (Journal).[/i][/b]

[*]Added a new ghost investigation score system that goes as follows: 5% for every question answered 60% for completing the ghost investigation and discovering the ghost's backstory. That makes it 100% for a successful investigation.

[*]Added new ghost investigation questions to the Notebook (Journal).

[*]Removed the ghost investigation restriction; now it is completely optional.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620600/c036fa24d12761b6cf4417feda9bbbbc4a918758.png"][/img]
[*]Fixed security camera moving noise when the player is not on the security app on the in-game computer.[/list]
[/p][hr][/hr]
[p][b][i]This update does not require manual action; restart Steam to get the latest update automatically.
[/i][/b]
As always, thanks for playing and supporting us! Feel free to share your experience in the community or join our [url="https://discord.com/invite/atNX56k5n7"]🎙️ Official Discord Server[/url].
[/p][hr][/hr]

[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620600/58783164112c3d14dab9510bebd93c26f670f192.png"][/img]Psychiatric Hospital
173 Brookwell Road, New Hills[/p]

notes.title: Calling All Observers! - Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
[h2]Calling patient number [REDACTED], please report to the main lobby.
[/h2]

[h3]LC Medical Psychiatric Hospital is happy to announce that Warning Launches on June 24th, 2025![/h3]

[previewyoutube=GgvBUYklpzQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]You are working as an observer in the psychiatric ward at the LC Medical Psychiatric Hospital.[/h3]

Step into the shoes of a night guard assigned to a long-abandoned psychiatric facility buried beneath the main asylum. For years, rumors have swirled: missing persons, unexplained noises, flickering lights, and the presence of something no one dares to name. Tonight, it’s your turn to keep watch.

[list]
[*]Monitor Security Cameras: Keep a vigilant eye on static-filled feeds, observing rooms where chairs move, doors open, and shadows stretch too far.
[*]Report Supernatural Anomalies: Identify and document each anomaly to maintain your safety. Miss too many, and the threat may no longer be confined to the screen.
[*]Survive the Shift: The ward is said to be sealed and safe, but as the night progresses, that promise unravels. The presence is within watches, waits, and reacts.
[*]Immersive Psychological Horror: Experience a game where what you see, and don't see, can be your undoing.
[/list]

Warning is a psychological horror game that puts your observation skills and nerves to the test. Keep watching. Keep reporting. And whatever you do, don’t look away.
